name: Quiqup Connector
author: naderquiqup

sections.installation:
As easy as 1, 2, 3

First install and activate the plugin.
You will then get redirected to Quiqup’s platform, where you will be able to configure your connection in a few guided steps.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial Woocommerce extension.
  • Generate API Key.
  • Redirect to Quiqdash.
sections.description:
A Woocommerce extension that connects your store to Quiqup Delivery, a top UAE e-commerce enabler for last mile and fulfillment services.

Seamlessly connect your store with Quiqup’s logistics platform to automate order fulfillment

Quiqup’s WooCommerce extension transforms the logistics experience for merchants by automating order imports and seamlessly integrating with our advanced delivery network.

Ideal for businesses of all sizes, this extension simplifies order fulfillment and delivery with flexible options, including same-day, next-day, and 4-hour delivery windows, plus international shipping.

With cash-on-delivery (COD) available within the UAE, it ensures a smooth, efficient process

Features:

  • Automated Order Import
  • Flexible Delivery Options
  • Real-Time Tracking
  • Seamless Integration

External services

The plugin redirects users to Quiqdash (Quiqup’s client portal for placing and managing orders) after activation. This serves to pass on the api key token,
which will allow the user to login and connect that key with the user id to place future api calls.

Support and Knowledge base
